title: 1510 - Instrutor De Tecnologia Para Escritorio
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Serviços de apoio técnico e suporte especializado em atividades laboratoriais para pesquisa aplicada à exploração, produção e refino de petróleo. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Registro e controle de custódia de amostras laboratoriais e suas subamostras;
Suportar a demanda de ensaios de química analítica: realizar protocolo de implantação/validação/desenvolvimento/processamento e realização de método analítico na área de química por: espectroscopia de absorção e emissão no ultravioleta, visível e por espectroscopia vibracional (infravermelho e Raman);
Emitir laudos de análise, especificar tecnicamente e encaminhar solicitações de compras de equipamentos e insumos em atendimento às exigências da legislação vigente e de forma a garantir a confiabilidade analítica do laboratório;
Preparo e análise dealíquotas de amostras de produtos (material de referência) e padrões de referência, bem como suas análises, para o Controle Estatístico de Processos (CEP) dos serviços de Análises – construção de curvas de calibração, validação de equipamentos e métodos analíticos;

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
The Company You'll Join Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page. The Problems You'll SolveAt Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Engineer, you will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients. In particular, you'll be one of the key contributors in improving operational efficiency, building new features while capitalizing on standardized solutions. Working in close collaboration with both business and engineering teams within Carta, we navigate a unique and challenging product space that intersects with multiple domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and various other teams. The Team You'll Work WithThe Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team's core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs. Some of the key problem areas you will be working on: Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult. Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency. Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.G., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views. Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren't well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics. About YouYou deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally: You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience. You have experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices. You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink (we invite you to check out our very own )). You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing. You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and are eager to explore how they can be applied to improve product experiences. You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value. You see communication as one of your strengths. You want to build and own your work end-to-end. You are eager to move fast but recognize when to build for the future. At Carta, you're not just an employee. You're a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional, and kind;
representing Carta's Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross-functionally to challenge the status quo, working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets. description:
Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore

PRIO Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore role at PRIO

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore para uma das nossas unidades:

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Reportar imediatamente ao Gerente da unidade qualquer risco real ou potencial observado durante a execução de qualquer atividade, paralisando o serviço caso o risco seja iminente.
  • Treinar, orientar e compor o time de resposta a emergência da unidade nas ações específicas de resposta, organizando e participando dos exercícios e simulados de emergência.
  • Realizar palestras e treinamentos de segurança e meio ambiente conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar e apoiar o Gerente da unidade e demais departamentos nas ações referentes às políticas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.
  • Disseminar a cultura de segurança, através de ações para promover a segurança entre nossos colaboradores, com o objetivo de difundir os princípios de segurança e fundamentos de segurança de processo.
  • Coordenar as auditorias de Permissões de trabalho e inspeções nos equipamentos e sistemas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar o atendimento à Matriz de Treinamento da equipe de bordo.
  • Assegurar que a equipe de técnicos de segurança seja treinada e capacitada na aplicação das ferramentas de gestão tais como Greendocs, procedimentos, sistema de PT digital, cartão de observação, registros de incidentes, inspeções rotineiras, listas de verificações, análises de riscos, permissões de trabalho, entre outros, por meio de treinamentos internos definidos nos procedimentos estabelecidos pela organização.
  • Contribuir e ser o facilitador nas investigações de acidentes/incidentes junto à operação, propondo ações de melhorias por meio de técnicas de análises eficazes que garantam a redução e/ou eliminação dos eventos indesejáveis.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico)

  • Formação técnica de Segurança do Trabalho.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória

  • Sólida experiência como Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore e com liderança de times.
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities

Equal Opportunity

  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Overview

Tudo o que fazemos é por acreditar que existe um grande potencial não explorado em cada ser humano. Nosso propósito é transformar a vida das pessoas ao descobrir sua melhor versão. Somos o melhor curso de comunicação e oratória do Brasil; ajudamos pessoas e empresas a melhorarem suas performances e resultados através de uma metodologia única e inovadora que combina técnicas de oratória, fonoaudiologia, neurociência, psicologia positiva e técnicas teatrais.

Nossa cultura: No nosso dia a dia, nos propomos a fazer diferente na vida dos nossos clientes e colaboradores de forma única e eficiente, porque acreditamos que cada ser humano é único e tem grande potencial a ser descoberto e desenvolvido. Isso se tangibiliza em atitudes práticas e em nossos valores:

  • Excelência: Ter compromisso por fazer o melhor, sempre. Valorizar o cuidado com os detalhes e a busca constante pela alta qualidade em tudo o que faz.
  • Coragem: Encarar as mudanças e desafios de frente, com confiança e determinação, acreditando que cada adversidade é uma oportunidade para o crescimento e transformação.
  • Inovação: Inovar com paixão e estar sempre em busca de novas ideias e soluções que tragam resultados impactantes, transformando vidas.
  • Sabedoria: Aprender e crescer continuamente. Investir em conhecimento e desenvolvimento e garantir o sucesso em tudo o que se propõe a fazer.
  • Bom humor: Cultivar um ambiente leve e descontraído. Saber encarar os desafios com positividade e leveza.
  • Acolhimento: Priorizar as pessoas, cuidar das relações e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho saudável.

Seus Principais Objetivos São:

  • Conectar com leads quentes e frios, com foco em gerar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  • Qualificar prospects e entender suas necessidades;
  • Aprimoramento e captação de informações comerciais;
  • Mapear oportunidades de venda e realizar a oferta de nossos produtos/serviços;
  • Agendar reunião para fechamento da venda entre o potencial cliente e nossos executivos de venda;
  • Qualificar e desenvolver os leads gerados por nossas estratégias de marketing;
  • Atualizar as informações no CRM e softwares de sales engagement com pontos relevantes sobre as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Trabalhar o social selling e aprofundar relacionamento com os leads por meio de canais sociais.

Procuramos por Pessoas (atentem-se às soft skills abaixo):

  • Pessoas com raciocínio lógico;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Ótima dicção;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão sistêmica;
  • Solucionadoras de problemas;
  • Criativas e empreendedoras;
  • Organizadas e disciplinadas para contribuir com a performance do time;
  • Que AMEM trabalhar em equipe (aqui não aceitamos egoísmo, nem competições não saudáveis);
  • Resilientes e Pacientes (confortáveis no desconforto e lidando com o desconhecido);
  • Proativas e Independentes (com vontade de aprender e resolver problemas de forma autônoma);
  • Que tenham espírito empreendedor.

  • Pacote Office básico;

  • Facilidade em aprender coisas novas.

Diferenciais:

  • Noções básicas de inglês; Experiência como SDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio na metodologia SPIN Selling;
  • Conhecimento de CRM.

Para você que se identifica e gosta de moda: a ViX Paula Hermanny está procurando um Supervisor de Logística.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Planejar e coordenar as operações logísticas, garantindo o abastecimento das lojas e e-commerce;
  2. Gerenciar o transporte e a distribuição dos produtos, otimizando rotas e custos;
  3. Supervisionar o recebimento, armazenamento e expedição de mercadorias;
  4. Monitorar indicadores de desempenho logístico (KPIs) e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  5. Controlar o nível de estoque para evitar rupturas e excessos, garantindo a disponibilidade dos produtos;
  6. Negociar com fornecedores e transportadoras para assegurar prazos e qualidade nos serviços prestados;
  7. Assegurar a correta aplicação das normas de segurança e boas práticas logísticas;
  8. Liderar a equipe operacional, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho produtivo e colaborativo;
  9. Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como Compras, Vendas e Planejamento para garantir a sinergia nas operações.

Requisitos:

  1. Formação em Logística, Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência na área de logística, preferencialmente no setor de moda ou varejo;
  3. Conhecimento em gestão de estoques, transportes e distribuição;
  4. Habilidade em ferramentas de ERP e WMS;
  5. Capacidade de liderança e gestão de equipe;
  6. Forte habilidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  7. Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente e realizar visitas operacionais.

Diferenciais:

  1. Experiência com logística omnichannel;
  2. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e melhoria contínua.

Local de trabalho: São Cristóvão, 100% presencial.

How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
APRESENTAÇÃO :

Prazer, somos a IDG!
Somos uma empresa que se espelha em fazer a diferença, em ser a diferença no mercado.
Fundada em 1999, a IDG Engenharia e Consultoria vem crescendo e criando raízes em princípios sólidos, como valorização do colaborador e fornecimento de serviços especializados e com total qualidade a seus clientes.

ESCOPO DO SISTEMA DE GESTÃO : Elaboração de Projetos Industriais Mecânico, Hidráulico, Elétrico, Automação e Civil para as indústrias de Mineração, Siderurgia, Petroquímica, Celulose e outros; Prestação de Serviços de Gerenciamento de Implantação de projetos industriais nas áreas de Mineração, Siderurgia, Celulose e outros.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite na ética e transparência profissional;
  • Uma pessoa que abrace nossos valores e direcionadores de cultura;

  • Ah, E não podemos esquecer alguém que acredite em si mesmo e que curta se autodesenvolver, busque cada vez mais conhecimento em sua área e não possua medo de explorá-la. Alguém que goste de desafios como nós!

  • Formação em Engenharia Mecânica.
  • 10+ anos de experiência em engenharia industrial, preferencialmente no setor siderúrgico.
  • Domínio de softwares de modelagem 3D (Autodesk Inventor, SAP2000, ROBOT, etc.).
  • Conhecimento avançado em normas técnicas brasileiras e internacionais (NBR, AISC, AISE6, CMAA 70, etc.).
  • Experiência em cálculos estruturais, análise de elementos finitos (FEM) e projetos multidisciplinares.
  • Habilidades comprovadas em elaboração de especificações técnicas, memórias de cálculo e desenhos técnicos.
  • Capacidade de coordenação de equipes e projetos complexos.

MODALIDADE DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

HORÁRIO DE TRABALHO:

  • De segunda à quinta – 07:40 às 17:28 e Sexta 07:40 às 14:58

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Refeição na empresa;
  • Transporte fretado.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Desenvolvimento de Projetos: Elaboração, revisão e consolidação de engenharia conceitual, básica e detalhada multidisciplinar. Desenvolvimento de projetos de implantação industrial, incluindo verificação de mecanismos cinemáticos, interferências e cálculos estruturais. Cálculos cinemáticos, dinâmicos, de resistência e flexibilidade para elementos de máquinas. Seleção de componentes mecânicos (redutores, acoplamentos, acionamentos, freios, engrenagens, correntes, etc.).
  • Análises e Especificações Técnicas: Análise de simultaneidades hidráulicas, pneumáticas e flexibilidade de tubulações. Elaboração de memórias de cálculo conforme normas brasileiras e internacionais (tensões, deformações, cálculos térmicos, hidráulicos, suportes, etc.). Verificação estrutural de galpões, edifícios e pontes rolantes (normas NBR, AISC, NBR8400, AISE6, CMAA 70). Cálculos de vasos de pressão conforme normas internacionais.
  • Coordenação e Planejamento: Elaboração de planos de coordenação entre especialidades (civil, elétrica, mecânica, tubulação, estruturas, etc.). Desenvolvimento de planos de cargas, chumbadores, calços e parafusos. Especificações técnicas para compra de equipamentos (redutores, motores elétricos, cilindros hidráulicos, correias transportadoras, etc.).
  • Documentação e Desenhos Técnicos: Execução de desenhos de fabricação e montagem mecânica, tubulação e elétrica. Desenvolvimento de projetos em 3D (preferencialmente utilizando Autodesk). Elaboração de animações, "As Built" e projetos de retirada de interferências. Revisão e atualização de documentos e desenhos existentes.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Assistência durante a obra, comissionamento e colocação em marcha. Levantamento de campo e planejamento de alternativas de projeto. Garantia de que toda documentação elaborada seja 100% exequível.

description:
Job Description

Job Number:

General Manager (Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro) (Job Number:HOT0BOG6 )

Work Locations

Work Locations: Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro Avenida Abelardo Bueno Barra

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.



What will I be doing?

As a General Manager, you are responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A General Manager will also be required to manage profitability and guest satisfaction measures. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage ongoing profitability of your hotel, ensuring revenue and guest satisfaction targets are met and exceeded
  • Lead in all key property issues including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment
  • Ensure all decisions are made in the best interest of the hotels and Hilton
  • Deliver achievable hotel budgets, and set other short- and long- term strategic goals for the property
  • Provide effective leadership to hotel team members
  • Lead in all aspects of business planning
  • Comply with and exceed Hilton Brand Service Standards
  • Ensure costs are controlled and revenue opportunities are effectively sourced and delivered
  • Manage and develop the Hotel Executive team to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within Hilton
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team
  • Respond to audits to ensure continual improvement is achieved
What are we looking for?

A General Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Experience as General Manager or Director of Operations within a similar quality hotel
  • Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Possesss strong commercial acumen, with experience in increasing profitability
  • Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar sized property
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel/leisure/service sector

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • General Management experience in a similar quality hotel


What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands . Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

description:
(2025) Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.
Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)
Desafios e Impacto
  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

description:
Join to apply for the Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle role at Águas do Rio .

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

O Programa Respeito dá o Tom nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Coordenar o planejamento e o controle operacional, garantindo alinhamento entre as metas de eficiência e o orçamento da companhia;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), elaborando diagnósticos e planos de ação que impulsionem resultados;

  • Estruturar relatórios e apresentações gerenciais, traduzindo dados complexos em informações estratégicas;
  • Atuar próximo às superintendências, fortalecendo a cultura de performance e eficiência.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em planejamento e controle voltado para eficiência operacional, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte, com unidades descentralizada;
  • Vivência prévia com gestão de pessoas e processos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos, orçamento e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Perfil analítico, firme e orientado a resultados, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de articulação entre áreas.

Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Principal Platform Engineer, Americas
description:
We’re looking for a curious, rigorous, problem-hungry platform engineer (who codes!) to carry the ball as we bring Ashby to the big leagues. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we’re hiring for this role.

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi I’m Colin, Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just hums along.

Our infrastructure is in a good place for now. Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We’re always looking to give our customers more powerful hiring software, and building new product features often requires new pieces of infrastructure.

Having herded plenty of snowflake servers in the past, I’ve learned there’s a better way. I (and Ashby) place a lot of value on code-as-infrastructure. As a Platform Engineer at Ashby, you’ll get to dive into scaling problems, add new capabilities to our platform, and think about how our entire team interacts with infrastructure. All our own engineers own their projects end-to-end and ship with minimal oversight. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. But with great power comes great responsibility: we handle personal and confidential data about some of the biggest decisions we ever make at work. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. That’s where you come in: you, too, will own projects end-to-end and have an impact on core parts of the Ashby developer and user experience. For instance, you could work on:

  • Optimize our homegrown ultra-dynamic recruiting DSL-to-SQL compiler, and create tools to help developers do so
  • Create automated guardrails for the security and privacy of our customer data
  • Help our developers ship features fast through canary deploys, gradual rollouts and feature flags, while keeping complexity manageable and reducing downtime
  • Work with the business and the engineering team to define SLOs and implement the corresponding SLIs.
  • Ensure all communication with external services supports circuit-breakers.
  • Implement the infrastructure to support an event-driven architecture and data warehouse.
Why you should or shouldn’t apply

You should apply if:

  • You never stop. You get weirdly obsessed about a problem that doesn’t yet make sense, turn it every which way in your head until the explanation dawns. You’ll search every rock, inventory every clue, hunt every mismatch. We do that, too – together we’ll be armed with state‑of‑the‑art monitoring tools and an impressive amount of data, and join you in the adventure.
  • You don’t take shortcuts. You’re speaking up for the future user, the edge case, the doomsday design. You know product engineers want to build it with you, and see them as allies, where you give them the power and knowledge to access greater things.
  • You’re someone who cares about what you do and the team you do it with, and want to work with others who do as well. You’ll be on interview panels choosing your next colleagues, and you’ll take that seriously. You only want to work with people who make you better, and want to make you better.
  • You’ve built infrastructure at a slightly later stage than Ashby is at - you know how to deal with millions of data points, have seen great (or not great) infrastructure make or break customer experience, and have automated everything from provisioning to monitoring and release process.
  • You’re a Swiss army knife (all nationalities welcome). You’ll get every hard problem the company faces. You’ll get to do infrastructure updates, security enforcements, database optimization, Kubernetes debugging, and digging through Typescript traces figuring out what doesn’t work. You probably don’t feel like an expert at at least some of that… and that appeals to you.

You should not apply if:

  • You don’t want to make your own decisions on what is the best paved road to build for Ashby, and expect a lead or manager to make the final call on what that is. Our leads (and managers) give ample commentary and feedback on technical decisions and how they’re made, but you ship what you want to build and are accountable for it.
  • You hate SQL. We have a lot of features built around making the best out of data, and our platform engineers also sometimes dive into a gnarly report or advise engineers on a more performant data model to use.
  • You don’t want to code. Our SREs are some of our best software engineers and they are just as responsible for the application as the other engineering teams – albeit at a platform level. Reviewing code and submitting code changes will be part of your day to day.
  • Your primary mode of communicating best practices to engineers is live meetings. We’re a very async culture and written communication (and code) is how changes get made. As an Ashby SRE, you will need to share new tooling and best practices with engineers faster than your next meeting opportunity will take you.
  • You’ve never delivered a project, on your own, without someone prodding you for updates. We have no project or delivery managers to fill your calendar with busy work, but the flip side is you have to do your project management, seek the help you need to get unstuck and cut scope when it’s worthwhile.
Technology Stack

We use TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis. We use Datadog and Sentry on 100% cloud‑based (AWS) infra. We take developer experience and reliability seriously: all engineers are on call in a follow‑the‑sun model, and everyone contributes to developer tooling.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top‑tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high‑quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
description:
Overview

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team’s mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role
  • Implement and evolve Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
Optional things we value
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats
What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

The Billing Coordinator will lead our Billing Team in delivering exceptional invoicing experiences to our valued clients in the Americas Region. In this role, you will supervise, develop, motivate, and mentor the Billing Team to ensure that all invoicing is carried out punctually, comprehensively, and with precision. Collaboration with various functions within Airswift, including Operations, Accounting, and Accounts Receivables, is crucial.   • Identify problems, propose alternatives, recommend solutions, and implement approved solutions.
  • Collaborate with the collections team to research and resolve billing issues or discrepancies, working closely with the sales and operations departments to ensure accuracy and contract compliance of disputed items.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 50,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long-term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer-facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third-party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event-driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You'll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we're building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript, Next.js, and/or Node.js
The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list). Finally, you'll have back-to-back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.
Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;

  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Join to apply for the Engenheiro(a) de Operações HSE Sênior role at TotalEnergies.

Contexte et environnement

O Brasil é um país altamente regulado, com exigências rigorosas de SSMS e necessidade de demonstração de gestão de riscos às autoridades como pré-requisito obrigatório para qualquer operação. A TotalEnergies EP Brasil é uma afilial estratégica para o Grupo, em fase de crescimento (200 mil bpd em participação do Grupo até 2025). A excelência na gestão de riscos operacionais contribui para a expansão do portfólio operado e para o aumento da influência sobre os parceiros responsáveis por ativos estratégicos operados por terceiros (OBOs). A excelência em SSMS, Segurança e Integridade garante a sustentabilidade da reputação da TotalEnergies no Brasil, ao mesmo tempo em que preserva a vida de todos os envolvidos.

Activités
  • Participar de estudos de perigos e avaliações de riscos para garantir a execução segura dos programas operacionais.
  • Aconselhar e aprimorar o reconhecimento de perigos e o controle de riscos nas mudanças de gestão.
  • Participar diretamente na implementação dos Programas de Segurança da TotalEnergies EP Brasil.

  • Dar assistência, aconselhar e aprimorar as análises de causa raiz de incidentes e incidentes com Alto Potencial.

  • Garantir a participação ativa na organização de reuniões de segurança pré-trabalho, com atenção especial para:
  • preparação de operações de içamento,
  • prevenção de queda de objetos,
  • prevenção de lesões nas mãos,
  • operações simultâneas e
  • operações críticas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar para garantir os prazos e acuidade dos relatórios de eventos, incidentes, acidentes e anomalias.
  • Garantir o monitoramento da performance de HSE e benchmarking relacionados os KPIs atualizados, conhecidos e acompanhados.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar no aprimoramento da competência e treinamento das equipes em HSE (empresa e contratados).
  • Garantir os prazos e acuidade ao reportar os eventos de HSE no sistema OneSynergi.
  • Fornecer treinamentos específicos de HSE no campo, conforme necessário, garantindo a inclusão de toda a supervisão dos contratados.
  • Verificar a aplicação da política de HSE e dos documentos de referência relacionados, incluindo os procedimentos da TotalEnergies EP Brasil e as Regras de HSE do Grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Desenvolver Documentos de Integração com Contratados (Bridging Documents) e garantir que sejam compreendidos, relevantes e utilizados nas atividades de execução dos programas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar o Gerente de Operações HSE.
  • Auxiliar, aconselhar e aprimorar os meios de identificação de perigos e controle de riscos em operações simultâneas (SIMOPS) e/ou situações degradadas.
  • Dar suporte no gerenciamento e na comunicação de forma eficaz ao pessoal de campo sobre ações corretivas relacionadas a acidentes, inspeções, auditorias e revisões.
  • Realizar auditorias e inspeções para garantir o devido alinhamento com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE da TotalEnergies e com o OneMAESTRO.
Responsabilidades
  • Aconselhar e auxiliar o Gerente de Operações HSE na aplicação da política de HSE e na execução eficaz dos programas de trabalho definidos.

  • Manter uma imagem profissional, ações e expertise técnica em todos os momentos.
